cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je získat znalosti o odborné anglické terminologii z oblasti účetnictví a daní. Student získá, procvičí a upevní si odbornou anglickou terminologii z této oblasti, kdy ji bude posléze schopen uplatňovat v praxi.

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Credit - student během semestru získává body, kdy maximálně je nutné získat alespoň 60 bodů. Body lze získávat: 1) Aktivita ve výuce - max 5 bodů; 2) Příprava prezentace nebo didaktické hry - max 40 bodů, délka prezentace je maximálně 10 minut; 3) Účast na Business Game od ACCA - max 5 bodů; 4) Zápočtový test - max 50 bodů. Zápočtový test bude mít písemnou formu a bude obsahovat: terminologii (slovíčka), definice pojmů a příklady. Časový limit na vypracování je 45 minut.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to gain knowledge of the English terminology from the field of accounting and taxes. We will discuss a lot in Czech and English language. The student will receive, excercise and fix the English terminology from the field of taxes and accounting. After that he/she will be able to use this terminology in practice.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Tax system and functions of taxes (allowance 0/2)2.Direct taxes - Individual Income Tax (allowance 0/4) a.Terminology in the field of direct taxationb.Principlesc.Methodology for determining the tax base and calculating the tax liability (individuals)3.Direct taxation - Corporate Income Tax (allowance 0/4) a.Terminologyb.Principlesc.Methodology for determining the tax base and calculating the tax liability (corporations)4.Other direct taxes (allowance 0/2) a.Real Estate Taxb.Road Tax5.Indirect taxes (allowance 0/2) a.Value Added Taxb.Excise Duty Taxc.Energy Taxes6.Accounting (allowance 0/2) a.Terminology in the field of accountingb.Accounting Regulations7.Basic principles of accounting (allowance 0/4) a.Terminologyb.Principles of double-entry bookkeeping8.Balance sheet and balance-sheet items (allowance 0/4) a.Terminologyb.Balance sheetc.The changes of balance-sheet items9.Profit and loss statement (allowance 0/2) a.Terminologyb.Expenses/Costs and revenuesc.Profit and loss statement10.Financial Statements (allowance 0/2) a.Terminologyb.Parts of Financial Statements

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Credit - the student can receive points during the semester, when at least 60 points must be obtained. Points can be received: 1) Activity during the classes - max 5 points; 2) Preparation of a presentation or didactic game - max 40 points, the length of the presentation is a maximum of 10 minutes; 3) Participation in the Business Game from ACCA - max 5 points; 4) Credit test - max 50 points. The credit test will have a written form and will contain: terminology (words), definitions of terms and examples. The time limit for elaboration is 45 minutes.
